title: The High Interest Trap: How Easy Loans Destroy Savings | Jungle Money Tales Ep 3 #shorts
description: When Bholu takes a fast loan from Drakon, Milo reveals how minimum payment traps double your debt. Learn how credit card interest works and how to pay off debt fast in Episode 3 of Jungle Money Tales.
twist: Drakon is not robbing the valley; he is trapped in a massive debt himself, owed to someone named G.
viewer_question: Which would you pay off first: high-interest credit debt or low-interest loans?

beat_sheet.previously: Gulab offered to double nuts in seven days, but smart valley animals stayed cautious while food was missing.
beat_sheet.hook: Bholu panics with winter 20 sunrises away and takes a trap loan from Drakon.
beat_sheet.want: Bholu wants winter food immediately, and Milo wants to protect Bholu from losing everything.
beat_sheet.obstacle: Drakon charges extreme interest (8 nuts for 5 borrowed) and offers a minimum payment trap of 1 nut per week forever.
beat_sheet.money_in_plot: Milo calculates the true compound interest cost of minimum payments and helps Bholu work extra to pay off the principal balance fast.
beat_sheet.clue: Drakon's ledger shows he owes a huge debt to someone marked with letter G.
beat_sheet.red_herring: Drakon seems like the villain stealing nuts, but he is actually deeply in debt to a secret party.
beat_sheet.midpoint_twist: Drakon is not the thief; he is desperate because he owes a massive nut debt to 'G'.
beat_sheet.darkest_moment: Drakon threatens to take Bholu's den by sunset, and Milo's bark calculation sheet gets destroyed in the rain.
beat_sheet.cliffhanger: Drakon whispers to Milo: 'I did not steal the nuts. And I am more scared than you.'

recap: Bholu borrowed nuts with hidden high interest, but Milo calculated the minimum payment trap and helped him clear the balance before winter.
cliffhanger: Drakon confessed he is terrified of the mysterious mastermind G who holds his debt.
disclaimer: For education only, not financial advice. Investing involves risk, including loss of money.
credits: 3D models by Quaternius (CC0). Voice: Google Gemini text-to-speech. Animated story for education only.

cast.name: Gulab
cast.role: charming trader who runs the Trading Post, always smiling, everybody trusts him (hidden mastermind, never reveal before the reveal episode)
cast.behaviour: calm, smooth, always smiling, walks slowly, never raises his voice, filmed from a friendly eye-level angle until the reveal
cast.catchphrase: Trust is the best currency, my friend.

cast.name: Milo
cast.role: hero, young fox who just started earning, clever and brave but impatient with money
cast.behaviour: runs fast, jumps with joy, shows shock or sadness when he makes a mistake; filmed from a high angle when scared

cast.name: Lakshmi
cast.role: kind honest cow, saves a little every day, protects the young
cast.behaviour: calm, gentle, eats while she talks, nods, never in a hurry

cast.name: Bholu
cast.role: funny impulsive donkey who buys shiny useless things, loyal friend who learns the hard way
cast.catchphrase: Oh my whiskers... I mean, oh my ears!
cast.behaviour: comic: big shock, sad, celebrates too early, arrives late running

cast.name: Drakon
cast.role: proud black wolf who runs the Fang Lending Den, lends nuts at huge interest and tricks the young; scary but can be beaten
cast.behaviour: walks slowly and menacingly, stands over others, filmed from a low angle, fights only at the climax

cast.name: Tinku
cast.role: Milo's loyal best friend, young husky, scared of everything but surprisingly brave, comic relief
cast.behaviour: jumps at every noise, hides behind Milo, big shock and relief reactions, runs in late
cast.catchphrase: I am not scared. My legs are just excited!

cast.name: Ragnar
cast.role: old white wolf, the money mentor of the valley, speaks rules in one short sentence
cast.voice_style: slow, calm, one short wise sentence
cast.behaviour: stands on a boulder, hardly moves, never runs, filmed from a low angle

shots.title: The Alpaca's Promise
shots.narration: Gulab offered double nuts, but smart animals hesitated while winter food was still missing.
shots.visual: Gulab stands smoothly beside his cart of golden feather tokens while Milo and Lakshmi watch cautiously.

shots.title: Winter Approaches
shots.narration: Bholu panicked with twenty sunrises left before snow, holding only two tiny acorn caps.
shots.visual: Bholu stands alone in the leaf-scattered meadow, staring at two tiny acorn caps in horror.

shots.title: Desperate Measures
shots.narration: Bholu ran into Drakon’s dark den. "I need five nuts right now!" said Bholu.
shots.visual: Bholu runs into Drakon's dark lending cave while Drakon watches coldly from above.

shots.title: The Lender's Offer
shots.narration: Drakon sneered sneeringly. "Take five nuts today, but pay back eight nuts next week."
shots.visual: Drakon towers over Bholu, sneering menacingly as he opens his claws.

shots.title: The Minimum Payment Trap
shots.narration: "Or pay one nut a week forever!" sneered Drakon. Bholu happily took the five nuts.
shots.visual: Drakon leans down while Bholu reaches out happily to take the fresh pile of nuts.

shots.title: Milo's Warning
shots.narration: Milo saw Bholu buying shiny useless berries. "That easy loan is a trap!" said Milo.
shots.visual: Milo walks quickly up to Bholu who is showing off golden berry snacks in the meadow.

shots.title: Blind Optimism
shots.narration: Bholu laughed loudly. "I only owe one small nut per week, Milo!" said Bholu.
shots.visual: Bholu laughs cheerfully and waves his ears while Milo rubs his forehead in frustration.

shots.title: Tinku's Panic
shots.narration: Tinku jumped behind Milo. "One nut forever means you pay back twenty nuts!" squeaked Tinku.
shots.visual: Tinku runs out from behind a tree, jumping in shock beside Milo and Bholu.

shots.title: The Math on Bark
shots.narration: Milo scratched numbers on bark, showing how minimum payments let high interest multiply endlessly.
shots.visual: Milo points at scratches on a piece of tree bark while Bholu looks bewildered.

shots.title: The Secret Ledger
shots.narration: Milo noticed Drakon's open ledger, showing a huge debt marked with a mysterious letter G.
shots.visual: Close-up of Milo staring in shock at an open stone slab inside Drakon's cave marked with letter G.

shots.title: Drakon's Own Trap
shots.narration: Drakon was not just a greedy lender; he owed hundreds of nuts to someone else!
shots.visual: Drakon steps into the doorway behind Milo, looking anxious rather than terrifying.

shots.title: Confrontation
shots.narration: Milo confronted Drakon bravely. "You are trapping Bholu while hiding your own secret debt!" said Milo.
shots.visual: Milo turns to face Drakon, walking forward bravely inside the shadowy cave.

shots.title: Drakon's Threat
shots.narration: Drakon growled fiercely at Milo. "Pay eight nuts by sunset or lose your cozy den!"
shots.visual: Drakon roars fiercely down at Milo, kicking the bark calculations to pieces.

shots.title: Darkest Hour in Rain
shots.narration: Milo sat in dark rain with Bholu, feeling completely defeated as winter cold arrived.
shots.visual: Milo and Bholu huddle together under cold falling rain, feeling hopeless.

shots.title: Ragnar's Wisdom
shots.narration: Ragnar stepped from mist calmly. "Pay off principal fast to stop borrowing costs," said Ragnar.
shots.visual: Old Ragnar walks out of the misty forest, standing tall on a mossy boulder.

shots.title: Earning the Freedom
shots.narration: Lakshmi gave them forage work. Milo and Bholu picked acorns all day without stopping.
shots.visual: Lakshmi watches kindly while Milo and Bholu work together gathering wild acorns.

shots.title: Debt Wiped Clean
shots.narration: Bholu paid Drakon eight nuts before sunset, wiping out the debt and saving future nuts.
shots.visual: Bholu walks up to Drakon near the cave entrance and hands over eight full nuts.

shots.title: Math Wins
shots.narration: Drakon took the nuts silently. Milo’s quick math crushed high interest before it grew.
shots.visual: Drakon inspects the eight nuts while Milo celebrates with a jump beside Bholu.

shots.title: Today We Learned
shots.narration: Today we learned: borrowing costs extra interest. Minimum payments prolong debt for years. For example, a $1,000 card balance at 24% APR paid at $40 monthly takes about 3 years and costs roughly $400 in interest.
shots.visual: Milo stands center stage with Bholu and Lakshmi as summary graphics appear.

shots.title: The Terrifying Confession
shots.narration: Which would you pay off first: high interest debt or low interest loans? Tell us below! Drakon whispered to Milo: "I did not steal the nuts. And I am more scared than you."
